title: Comparison of surgical outcomes with and without Ologen collagen matrix augmentation during XEN gel stent implantation

indication: open-angle glaucoma (primary and secondary open-angle glaucoma) progressing or uncontrolled on maximum tolerated medical therapy, some eyes after previous trabeculectomy; ab externo XEN gel stent with 0.04% mitomycin C, standalone or combined with phacoemulsification, with or without Ologen collagen matrix augmentation (allocation by period of device availability); retrospective, one eye per patient

groups.description: Standalone XEN with Ologen augmentation (Table 3 column C2 'Oloxen')
Standalone XEN without Ologen (Table 3 column C3 'Xen')
XEN combined with phacoemulsification, with Ologen augmentation (Table 3 column C5 'Phaco-Oloxen')
XEN combined with phacoemulsification, without Ologen (Table 3 column C6 'PhacoXen')

decision: no admissible series; no record written

exclusions.what: Table 3 (Tab3) rows R3 to R8 (1 day, 1 week, 3 weeks, 6 weeks, 3 months, 6 months), columns C2, C3, C5 and C6
exclusions.reason: the cells report 'IOP reduction (%) from baseline' (caption; positive values mean a lower IOP), which is the negative of the protocol value kind percent_change = 100 × (IOP − reference)/reference. Protocol 1.0.0 and its record builder store the cited cell numbers without any sign transformation, so these cells cannot be recorded faithfully under any admissible value kind; no absolute or signed IOP series is tabulated for any group
reference values without an admissible tabulated follow-up series

exclusions.what: Surgical success rates and Table 4 (Tab4) hypotony, 5-FU injections, needling, medications and additional surgery
exclusions.reason: success proportions and counts are not admissible; medication counts are mentioned in notes only

notes: Tonometer: Goldmann applanation tonometry (Methods, baseline examination).
Reference: all anti-glaucoma medications were continued until surgery (Methods), so a reference would be preoperative_medicated.

Some Table 3 cells carry parenthetical counts of additional surgery (trabeculectomy, repeat XEN implantation, Ologen removal) at that visit (footnote 'Parenthesis; additional surgery'); the article does not state whether those eyes remain in the later means.

The triage owner override admitted the study on the basis that percent_change needs no reference value; the blocking issue found at extraction is the opposite sign convention of the tabulated percent reduction, which would need a declared sign-negation transform in a later protocol version.
Role: Ologen collagen matrix augmentation is the adjunct compared against non-augmented XEN, recorded as treated; non-augmented arms as control.
